clues: This small place lies in the south of Liège in Belgium. It sits at the foot and slope of a hill.
In July 2019, heat broke a new record here. The air hit forty point two degrees Celsius, the most heat ever seen in Belgium.
This place stood on its own until 1977. In that year, it merged into the city of Liège.
Two mansions stand down in its lower part. One is called Péralta, and the other is Nagelmackers.
Find the science park by the roundabout at Sart Tilman. That hilltop park is the mark of its high part.
